newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PRI Automation started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PRI Automation started.

text.p: -- Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette analyst Robert Maire on Thursday started coverage of PRI Automation Inc with a rating of buy.
-- In a report, he set a 12-month price target for the stock of $70.
-- Shares in the Billerica, Mass., maker of factory automation systems closed on Wednesday at 48.
-- Maire called the company a "silicon express," adding, "PRI is one of the most rapidly growing companies in the semiconductor equipment industry."
-- He set an estimate for earnings per share of $2.15 in 1997 and of $2.80 in 1998.
